name: WANTED: Bruuz
objectiveText: Bring Bruuz's Dorsal Fin to Gazlowe in Ratchet. Bruuz's Dorsal Fin  ( 1 )

comments.body: Pronounced "Bruce," this is a reference to mechanical shark that was used in Jaws, whose nickname was Bruce.
Just soloed it as a level 18 warlock without any help from the guards. www.youtube.com/watch?v=qcPM5tsFRC0

[Beta]: Solo'd as level 20 prot paladin - kited him back to the dock and got help from a Ratchet Bruiser. Probably could have killed it alone but it would have been close. Did not drop anything besides the quest item. Hit me for 40-50 about every 1.5 sec.
replies: Managed to solo him completley in the water. lvl 20 prot paladin aswell. Had to use bubble and 1 bandage total.

comments.body: This is also available to members of the Alliance. Soloed as 24 Gnome Priest by kiting near a guard.
